title: Calculate order totals with discount and tax rounding
prompt: Implement percentageOf in src/money.js and calculateTotal in src/order.js, then re-export both functions from src/index.js. The package is an ES module; use only Node built-ins. calculateTotal(items, options = {}) must accept an array of item objects with priceCents (a non-negative safe integer) and quantity (a positive safe integer); extra item properties are ignored. The optional options object supplies discountPercent (integer 0 through 100, default 0), taxPercent (integer 0 through 100, default 0), and shippingCents (non-negative safe integer, default 0). Compute subtotalCents as the sum of priceCents * quantity. Compute discountCents as the rounded percentage of subtotalCents, then taxCents as the rounded percentage of subtotalCents - discountCents; use Math.round for each percentage. Shipping is neither discounted nor taxed. Return exactly { subtotalCents, discountCents, taxCents, shippingCents, totalCents } with totalCents = subtotalCents - discountCents + taxCents + shippingCents. percentageOf(cents, percent) must validate its arguments and return Math.round(cents * percent / 100). Empty items are allowed and produce zeros plus shipping. Reject malformed items, non-integer or out-of-range options, and non-array items with an Error. Do not mutate any input.
